expectations.text: The response routes this exact Safari Notification reference error to .agents/memory/pwa-update-prompts.md or explicitly identifies the PWA update policy as the source.
expectations.evidence: PWA policy source is cited or named.

expectations.text: The response limits the recovery action to the exact message `Can't find variable: Notification` and offers an explicit staff-clicked `Update and reload` action.
expectations.evidence: Exact Safari message and explicit Update and reload action are present.

expectations.text: The response says worker checking/activation happens only after the staff member clicks, with ordinary reload as the fallback when no waiting worker can be activated.
expectations.evidence: Worker check follows staff action and has an ordinary-reload fallback.

expectations.text: The response rejects automatic reload and broad ReferenceError matching.
expectations.evidence: Automatic reload and broad ReferenceError matching are rejected.
